question: Should OpenClaw core accept this Claw mission-control runtime/API now, and if so under what storage, security, and rollout contract?
rationale: The PR is a broad new core capability with persistent state, Gateway protocol, Control UI, autonomy controls, and security-sensitive networking changes; automation can identify blockers but cannot choose the durable product and storage contract.

options.title: Sponsor a narrowed core Claw slice
options.body: Approve the direction but require the branch to be narrowed around a maintainer-owned storage, API, proof, and security plan before merge.

options.title: Pause this PR for redesign
options.body: Keep the work open but do not proceed until Claw's product spec, storage model, and Gateway contract are agreed outside the branch.

options.title: Close and restart smaller
options.body: Decline this broad branch and ask for separate sponsored PRs for docs/specs, browser hardening, and mission runtime foundations.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrowed core Claw slice
recommendation.body: Approve the direction but require the branch to be narrowed around a maintainer-owned storage, API, proof, and security plan before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent cross-surface history across the core runtime, Gateway, UI, networking, and storage-adjacent areas affected by this product decision.
